description: Source code for the FrameTree class and related classes managing browser frames, workers, WebSocket events, and navigation in Firefox, part of Mozilla's internal developer tools or automation framework.

classes.name: FrameTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchy of browser frames, navigation, and worker debugging in Firefox.

classes.name: IsolatedWorld
classes.description: Represents an isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a single browser frame, manages its execution contexts, WebSocket events, and navigation state.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a dedicated web worker associated with a frame.

methods.name: setInitScripts
methods.description: Sets scripts to evaluate on new document creation within isolated worlds.

methods.name: _ensureWorld
methods.description: Ensures an isolated world exists for a given name.

methods.name: _frameForWorker
methods.description: Retrieves the frame associated with a worker debugger.

methods.name: _onDOMWindowCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new DOM window, initializing frame state.

methods.name: setJavaScriptDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables JavaScript execution in all frames.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new worker debugger, creating a Worker instance.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of a worker debugger, cleaning up.

methods.name: allFramesInBrowsingContextGroup
methods.description: Returns all frames within a browsing context group.

methods.name: isPageReady
methods.description: Checks if the page is marked as ready.

methods.name: forcePageReady
methods.description: Marks the page as ready and emits an event.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a script binding to a specified isolated world.

methods.name: frameForBrowsingContext
methods.description: Retrieves a frame for a given browsing context.

methods.name: frameForDocShell
methods.description: Retrieves a frame for a given docShell.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame by its ID.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames in the main frame's hierarchy.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the FrameTree instance.

methods.name: onWindowEvent
methods.description: Handles window events related to DOM element insertion and drag events.

methods.name: _frameNavigationCommitted
methods.description: Handles logic after a frame's navigation is committed.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles web progress state changes, such as navigation aborts.

methods.name: onLocationChange
methods.description: Handles location change events for frames.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextAttached
methods.description: Handles new browsing contexts being attached.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextDetached
methods.description: Handles browsing contexts being detached.

methods.name: _createFrame
methods.description: Creates a new Frame instance for a browsing context.

methods.name: _detachFrame
methods.description: Detaches and disposes a frame.
